name: Charges Per Transaction Record 6
definition: Provides a detailed breakdown of the charges per payment transaction.

RecordIdentification.name: Record Identification
RecordIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the charges record for reconciliation purpose.

ChargesRequestor.name: Charges Requestor
ChargesRequestor.definition: Agent that requests the charges, if other than the sender.

SettlementInstruction.name: Settlement Instruction
SettlementInstruction.definition: Specifies the details on how the settlement of the subsequent transaction(s) is completed.||Usage: this agent and party data should be mapped as-is onto the resulting message for the payment of the charges.

UnderlyingTransaction.name: Underlying Transaction
UnderlyingTransaction.definition: Identifies the underlying transaction(s) to which the charges apply.

TotalChargesPerRecord.name: Total Charges Per Record
TotalChargesPerRecord.definition: Total charges claimed for the transaction record.

ChargesBreakdown.name: Charges Breakdown
ChargesBreakdown.definition: Provides the detailed breakdown of the charges per type.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date and time at which the charges are or will be available.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.definition: Specifies the debtor of the initial payment transaction.

DebtorAccount.name: Debtor Account
DebtorAccount.definition: Specifies the account of the debtor of the initial payment transaction.

DebtorAgent.name: Debtor Agent
DebtorAgent.definition: Specifies the debtor agent of the initial payment transaction, if different from the charges account agent.

DebtorAgentAccount.name: Debtor Agent Account
DebtorAgentAccount.definition: Specifies the account of the debtor agent of the initial payment transaction, when instructing agent is different from the charges account owner.

ChargesAccountAgent.name: Charges Account Agent
ChargesAccountAgent.definition: Agent that services the charges account.||Usage: this element should be used where the charge being claimed does not relate to the processing of a payment transaction e.g. it relates to an investigation or other process. This identifies the agent that services the account from which charges are to be settled from.

ChargesAccountAgentAccount.name: Charges Account Agent Account
ChargesAccountAgentAccount.definition: Account of the agent that services the charges account.||Usage: this element should be used where the charge being claimed does not relate to the processing of a payment transaction e.g. it relates to an investigation or other process. This identifies the account from which charges are to be settled from.

InstructionForInstructedAgent.name: Instruction For Instructed Agent
InstructionForInstructedAgent.definition: Further information related to the processing of the payment adjustment instruction that may need to be acted upon by the next agent.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Further details on the reason for the charges.
